I had an X-ray (Dr. Champ explained the condition of my gums and teeth in detail) and fillings. I also had a tooth spa, scaling, and Airflow treatment. Dr. Champ was incredibly gentle and meticulous.

I also decided to get my teeth whitened, as I smoke and drink coffee. My teeth were originally A4 grade, but Dr. Champ improved them to about A1 grade, which is very impressive. The price was also great, and it was covered by social security insurance.

Thank you so much, Dr. Champ, and I look forward to seeing you again!
